title: Address Form
content: Build comprehensive address form with autocomplete. Fields: street address line 1, line 2 (optional), city, state/province, postal/ZIP code, country. Country selector: dropdown affecting state options. Address autocomplete: integrate Google Places API to fill all fields from selection. Validation: per-country postal code format. Compact layout: two columns where appropriate (city + state).

variants.simple: Create address form with street, city, state, and postal code fields.
variants.detailed: Build comprehensive address form with autocomplete. Fields: street address line 1, line 2 (optional), city, state/province, postal/ZIP code, country. Country selector: dropdown affecting state options. Address autocomplete: integrate Google Places API to fill all fields from selection. Validation: per-country postal code format. Compact layout: two columns where appropriate (city + state).
variants.advanced: Build comprehensive address form with autocomplete and international support. Fields: street address line 1 (required), street address line 2 / apt / suite (optional), city (required), state/province/region (required for applicable countries), postal/ZIP code (required, format varies), country (required, affects other field options). Country selector: dropdown with all countries (250+), flag + name display, searchable, changing country updates state/province options and postal code validation. State selector: dynamic dropdown based on country (US: 50 states + territories, CA: 13 provinces/territories, UK: no states needed, AU: 8 states/territories), conditionally required. Address autocomplete: integrate Google Places Autocomplete API or similar (Mapbox, HERE). Implementation: input with onInput triggering debounced API call, show suggestions dropdown below input, on selection call getPlace() to get full address components, auto-fill all fields from structured response. Manual entry: "Enter address manually" link expands full form, bypassing autocomplete for edge cases. Validation: per-country postal code format validation (US: 5 digits or 5+4, UK: complex pattern, CA: A1A 1A1), show error if format invalid. Required fields: mark with asterisk (*), validate on blur and submit. Compact layout: grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 where appropriate (city + state same row, postal + country same row on desktop), stack on mobile. International: support international address formats (some countries have different field orders, some don't use postal codes). Save address: checkbox "Save this address for future orders" for logged-in users, address book dropdown for saved addresses. Accessibility: proper labels, autocomplete attributes (autocomplete="address-line1", "postal-code", "country"), announce suggestions to screen readers.
